summary: Tududi is a task management application featuring hierarchical task structures and smart recurring schedules. It also includes integrated support for Telegram messaging to help manage items directly from chat interfaces.
goodFor: It suits users who want to organise complex to-do lists in a nested hierarchy while keeping track of tasks through Telegram.
watchOut: As a relatively niche project compared to established alternatives like Nextcloud Tasks or Vikunja, it may lack extensive community documentation or plugins.
deployNotes: Since it runs via Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for data storage and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
